sketch:
Observe: SVG scene showing an energy flow: a source (sun, wind,
battery), a converter (solar panel, turbine, motor), and a use (light
bulb, heater, mechanical work). Colored arrows animate energy
transferring from box to box (thickness ∝ power, red band = lost as
heat). Sliders: input power, converter efficiency (%). HUD: P_in,
P_out = η·P_in, P_lost = (1-η)·P_in. Student picks a source /
converter / use combination from dropdowns. Experiment: reach a target
useful output by tuning input and picking a converter. Evaluate:
energy arrows hidden; student picks correct converter type from
dropdown to match a target output. Wrinkle: 1ère-depth — names forms
(chemical, kinetic, thermal, radiant) and "chaîne énergétique".
